extra.reason: Accepted async job-based model with MVP defaults: polling-only (no webhook), 15-min job timeout (ENGINE_TIMEOUT), no cancellation. Lifecycle queued->running->succeeded|failed. Spec: docs/decisions/21.2-execution-model.md

Accepted: required request_id (UUIDv4 idempotency key, 7-day dedup, 409 on key reuse w/ different body, correlation-id tracing) + contract_version (schema negotiation, 400 on unsupported; distinct from engine_version). Spec: docs/decisions/21.4-request-id-and-contract-version.md

Accepted: single canonical source_type enum (email|rfi|site_instruction|meeting_note|sms|document) shared by input documents and output evidence; dropped ambiguous instruction/note; added source_document_id traceability. Spec: docs/decisions/21.1-evidence-type-vocabulary.md

Accepted: two orthogonal axes (detection confidence_score 0-1 vs valuation confidence); canonical band mapping low<0.5<=medium<0.8<=high; engine-derived confidence_band; status kept orthogonal to confidence. Spec: docs/decisions/21.3-confidence-system.md

Accepted (founder-approved): modular-monolith product (FastAPI) + STATELESS reused engine; product owns all persistence (Postgres); inline result delivery per v1.1; AWS ap-southeast-2 (Sydney); separate worker process (same image) as the v1.1 contract client driving the async/15-min job model. Spec: docs/architecture.md

Complete: engine client + worker built against contract v1.1 (submit/poll/backoff/15-min timeout, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claim, result ingestion, idempotent enqueue), full runtime glue (config/db/S3 loader/entrypoint), 21 passing tests (no live LLM/Postgres), and Alembic baseline 0001_initial reproducing the schema (offline-verified). Engine is reused as a stateless black box; product owns persistence.

Reconciled/superseded: implemented in real changeorder-recovery engine (INGEST+BASELINE). Reference removed. Reused via v1.2 adapter (.24). Blockers .4-.8 are product-side ingestion, not needed to consider this engine stage done.

Built v1.2 engine adapter in changeorder-recovery on branch feat/v1.2-engine-adapter (commit 05a670c, NOT pushed). app/adapter_v1.py: async POST /v1/analyses + poll wrapping stateless run_recovery; flags->variations mapping (confidence/100+band, time_bar_risk, estimate range, basis_quality->valuation band, evidence type lookup, minted variation_id); baseline surfaced; in-memory job store w/ 15-min cap + idempotency; lazy SDK import; router wired into main.py. 11 tests pass (mapping + jobstore, no live LLM).

Product layer updated to contract v1.2: engine schemas (contract_text/scope_text/state input; time_bar_risk/estimate range/basis_quality/confidence_factors + baseline output); models + schema.sql + alembic baseline gain basis_quality enum, projects.contract_text/scope_text/state, analysis_jobs.baseline/recoverable_total/time_bar_at_risk, variations.confidence_factors/time_bar_risk, value_estimates.estimate_low/high/basis_quality; worker build_request supplies contract/scope/state from Project; ingest_result maps all new fields + job rollups. 21 tests pass; alembic offline render verified.

No product task dropped. Verdicts: .2 BUILD greenfield; .3 HYBRID (reuse parsing.py); .14 BUILD+port triage/data-moat; .16 HYBRID (reuse frontend scaffold+payload); .17 BUILD+port audit pattern; .18 covered by .21 worker.

Reconciled/superseded: variation detection is implemented in the real changeorder-recovery engine (CLASSIFY stage: detect_variations over NormalisedDocs vs ScopeBaseline -> flags). Consumed by the product via the v1.2 adapter (flags->variations). No separate product implementation needed.

Built product auth + multi-tenant orgs (greenfield per .26). app/auth/{security(bcrypt),tokens(JWT HS256),service(signup/authenticate),deps(get_current_user/get_memberships),router(/auth/signup|login|me)} + app/main.py (product FastAPI app). Built project creation + completed-project upload (HYBRID). app/parsing.py ported from engine (PDF/text extract + forgiving comms-CSV reader + kind->source_type). storage.py gains put() (S3 + local). services/projects.py: org-scoped create/list/get + set_contract + add_document (writes to store, registers Document). auth/deps.ensure_member org-isolation guard. routers/projects.py: POST/GET /projects (membership-scoped), /{id}/contract + /{id}/comms upload (parse->persist), /{id}/analyze (enqueue_analysis -> job_id). Built commercial review workflow (queue, detail, approve/reject transitions+audit, comments). 7 tests pass (46 total). Blockers .12/.13 were engine stages (now reconciled-closed).

Built security & permissions (RBAC + org member management). auth/deps.require_admin (admin-only guard atop ensure_member). services/orgs.py: list_members, add_member (existing user by email, audited), set_role, remove_member - all admin-gated with LAST-ADMIN lockout protection + AuditLog. routers/orgs.py: GET/POST /orgs/{cid}/members, PATCH/DELETE /orgs/{cid}/members/{uid}, all require_admin. Org isolation (company_id scoping) enforced across all routers via ensure_member/require_admin. 9 tests pass (55 total): admin-allows/member-rejects guard, add_member+audit, unknown-email, last-admin demote/remove blocked, remove-with-other-admin-ok, endpoint 403-non-admin + 201-admin. No DB change (existing tables).
